text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and Tamamo Cross reached the Senior Year.
And so, for our New Year's Hatsumode visit—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The time's finally here, Trainer.
This year... This year, I'm gonna pull it off for sure!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just kept waitin'.
For nearly two years since my debut, building up my body,
just waitin' quietly...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I ain't holdin' back this year anymore.
I'll unleash all this cracklin', sizzlin' power I've built up!”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make it explode on the turf!
I'll show 'em the real "White Lightning"!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And make my family happy!
Sending lots of money and gifts back home!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're gonna do this together!
Alright, let's pray!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside Tamamo Cross, I pray to conquer the Twinkle Series.
My hands press together with fervent resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing our Hatsumode visit, we walked through the town...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, for the start of the New Year, I wanna send something real nice home first."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How about this!? Why not go all out
and get a whole house?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Did I try too hard...?
But still, I really wanna send something.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Even so, I've got no sense for picking stuff out. I don't really get fancy luxury items and all that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, could ya pick something out for me?
A New Year's gift my family'd like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having been asked, I decided to pick one.
The one that would probably make them happiest is...
choice_data_list: A photo trying to look grown-up

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Delicious sweets? Yeah, fair point. If I get 'em
somethin' they've never tried, the little ones'll be thrilled.
choice_data_list: Let's check out the department store basement.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... That super high-up place, right?
Guess so... Maybe just for New Year's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we arrived at the department store's basement food hall.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, there are food samples. Let me try a bite of this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Munch munch munch...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, th-this is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I can't quite figure out this taste... It's so fancy
I can't tell if it's delicious or gross. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that sweetness really hits the spot! I feel like
I could run two or three more reps right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The refined sweetness of high-end sweets turns into energy right away.
It should be perfect for growing kids full of energy like my younger siblings.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A photo where I'm "trying too hard"~? What's that supposed to mean?!
Just 'cause I'm short, ya want me to stand on my tiptoes or something...?!
choice_data_list: Instead of that, let's show them how much you've grown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so that's what you mean.
You wanna show 'em "look how great I've grown" and make 'em proud, eh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go somewhere we can take a photo like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I looked for a few places where she could show off her growth and brought Tamamo Cross along.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ooh, the student council room, huh? True, this'd be the perfect place to snap photos that make me look all successful.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like this? Well, to be honest, when it comes to comedy,
mine is way better than Rudolf's puns!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a haunted house next, seriously?! N-N-No
way I can walk through a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah. Now that I've grown...
S-Smile time~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I took photos of her posing pompously here and there. Tamamo Cross seemed to be feeling a bit more confident.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Unusual stuff from Tokyo, huh. I see.
There really are a lot of shops selling weird things there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The little ones might find it fun too.
Alright, let's go check it out."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this!?
"Panda Mask"...
That's so ridiculously cute...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
T-There's even a Kabuki mask face pack.
If Mom wore something like this,
it'd definitely give everyone a shock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rummaged through various merchandise and sent a bundle to my family.
Being exposed to all sorts of fun ideas broadened my perspective.
